summary: Implementation plan for KtScribe multi-language IDE: dynamic theme application across all UI components, expanding languages to Kotlin, Java, Python, Dart, C++, and Rust with distinct extensions and badges, separate Main vs Intra-File Settings, 2 default floating window dimensions (horizontal & vertical) with corner drag resizing and minimum size clamps, and variable split-screen clamped between 25% and 75% with a responsive drag handle.
